title: Blast radius
noDownstream: {count} changed symbol(s), no downstream callers found.

reason.flag_off: Repository intelligence is turned off, so callers come from a text search.
reason.index_failed: The last index run failed, so callers come from a text search.
reason.index_partial: The index is partial: some files were skipped, so callers may be missing.
reason.repo_too_large: The repository is too large to index fully, so callers may be missing.
reason.no_data: This repository has no usable index yet. Callers come from a text search, and endpoints and crons are not attributed.

error: Could not load the blast radius.
limitHint: Showing at most {max} callers per symbol.

history.title: Prior PRs touching these files
history.expand: Show prior PRs touching these files
history.collapse: Hide prior PRs touching these files
history.empty: No merged PRs touched these files.

degraded.no_clone: The repository is not cloned locally, so its history cannot be read.
degraded.github_unavailable: GitHub is not reachable (no token or an API error), so prior PRs cannot be listed.
degraded.partial: Some commits could not be looked up on GitHub, so the list may be incomplete.
